decisions.story_title: Dutch websites hit by malicious ad-tech code targeting visitors including iPhones
decisions.reason: Primary reporting from scientias.nl on a real, ongoing incident: early November 2026 malicious code distributed via the ad-tech of multiple Dutch sites (VI.nl, GeenStijl, Bright.nl, Scientias) collecting visitor data and targeting iPhones. Substantive security event, corroborated by NOS, NRC, Tweakers and others.

provenance.evidence: Site's own security notice: malicious code spread via ad technology early November 2026, could collect website-visit data and attempted to exploit vulnerabilities; same campaign reported by NOS, NRC, Tweakers across multiple Dutch sites.
